description:
# Integration Marketplace

Create a marketplace for integrations with external tools (IDEs, CI/CD, project management, communication). Include official integrations for popular tools and community-contributed ones.

## Rationale
Expands Turret's reach and reduces friction for teams using various tools. Addresses user pain point about parallel development coordination by integrating with existing workflows.

## User Stories
- As a developer, I want to connect Turret to our Jira so that tasks sync automatically
- As a team, we want Slack integration so that everyone gets notified of progress

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Integration catalog shows available connections
- [ ] Official integrations for GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Slack
- [ ] One-click installation for integrations
- [ ] Integration health monitoring and troubleshooting
- [ ] Community can submit integrations for review
